description: A set of special methods that built-in syntax relies on. Implementing `__len__` and `__getitem__` makes a class behave like a sequence.
Has a stable hash, so it can be a dict key or set member.
Since Python 3.7 a `dict` remembers the order in which keys were first inserted.
Abstract base classes (`Sequence`, `Mapping`, `MutableMapping`) that provide mixin methods once you implement the minimum.
`str` is Unicode text; `bytes` is raw data. Converting between them needs an encoding.
